params.slot: slot j of a level-L vector: value at exp(i*pi*k_j/2^L), k = slots[L][j]
params.tape: SamplerZ outputs in call order: node T1 then T0, leaf z0 then z1

scope.conditioning: SamplerZ replaced by the tape: call j answered by tape[j]; z is the unique solution of s = (c,0) - zB (zOfSig, checked exactly)
scope.hypothesis: refVec_sound: every point C with twOk C.x.rc and check C.x C.xn delta45q k = true at that point (rm, rc, dm, root, xn all enter check), unbounded words; refVec_word: the same at (i+64)-bit words, 1 <= i, when magOkB C.target i; refVec_exact: the exact values (fG - gF = q)
scope.controlNote: check holds at the evaluated points marked true
scope.notCovered: binary64 (floating-point) implementations; operation orders other than the Choices order (fftW, splitW, mergeW, updW, targetX; only the target has two orders), e.g. another association order or a half-spectrum FFT; key expansion on words (the tree is the unbounded storeC C.x C.xn k, also in refVec_word); the printer is not proved
scope.reading: necessary, not sufficient: a value outside its disc is not produced by any point satisfying the hypothesis; a value inside shows nothing more (one key, one message, one tape)
